title.narrative: Strengthening resilience on water-related disaster under climate change for a sustainable society in Ghana

description.narrative:
The increasing frequency and intensity of floods and droughts in Ghana highlight the urgent need for enhanced water-related disaster resilience. The Akosombo Dam spillage in October 2023 caused extensive flooding, damaging critical infrastructure. Another major flood in November 2023 displaced hundreds in the Greater Accra Region. Since early 2023, flooding has affected 88,000 people along the Volta River. Severe drought in 2024 impacted over one million people, causing significant economic losses.
This project aims to improve flood and drought resilience in Ghana through innovative, inclusive, and science-based interventions. It includes developing an integrated early warning system, conducting water-related hazard assessments, and strengthening institutional and human capacity.
